note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 by an independent auditor who authored neither f9a295a7cf nor 37b21d0c46. RFC 7606 Section 7.16, New Text: "An UPDATE message with a malformed ATTR_SET attribute SHALL be handled using the approach of "treat as withdraw"." RFC 6368 Section 5 still defines malformed, including "The included attributes are malformed themselves." The only unit change since the last verdict is the new TestRFC7606AttrSetIncludedASSetKeepsRoute; the eight other units are byte-identical and their earlier judgement stands (exact TreatAsWithdraw with AttrCode 128 for malformed inner attributes, nesting cap, inner discard, MP_REACH presence, short length; exact None for conforming ATTR_SETs with 4-octet inner AS_PATH and inner iBGP attributes on eBGP). New unit, positive: an ATTR_SET whose included AS_PATH holds an AS_SET or AS_CONFED_SET, or whose included AS4_PATH holds an AS_SET, draws exact RFC7606ActionNone from ValidateUpdateRFC7606Peer under acceptASSet false and true, with a set-free top-level AS_PATH so only code 128 is judged. That input is conforming: RFC 7606 Section 7.2 and RFC 4271 Section 4.3 make AS_SET a valid segment type, and RFC 9774 Section 3 binds "reception of BGP UPDATE messages containing AS_SETs or AS_CONFED_SETs in the AS_PATH or AS4_PATH [RFC6793]." without calling a set malformed. Interop check read at source: FRR bgpd/bgp_attr.c has no ATTR_SET case, code 128 falls to "default: ret = bgp_attr_unknown(&attr_args);"; BIRD proto/bgp/attrs.c sends it to the "Unknown attribute" branch, bgp_decode_unknown. Neither inspects the included path, so keeping the route matches both. Negative: the same included AS_SET holding AS 0 (RFC 7607 Section 2 malformed) draws exact TreatAsWithdraw, AttrCode 128 and the exact description "... an included attribute is itself malformed, code (2)" under both policies, which also proves the producer's receivePolicy{acceptASSet: true} at the inner validateAttribute call (validateAttrSetDepth) keeps the structural and AS 0 checks while dropping only the set scan. The earlier finding (no test pinned the inner AS_SET reading) is closed by this unit. Discrimination records exist for both polarities of the new unit on validateAttrSetDepth. Units ran green at HEAD (go test -run TestRFC7606AttrSet, message package; TestRFC7606AttributeEnvelopeSession, reactor).
